_comment: The committed network policy of the live trading zone.
app_spec.xml, Trust Zone Isolation & Secrets, feature 156:
System rejects access to the live trading host that does not
arrive through a bastion session, because no inbound port is
on the live trading host. Access via bastion or session manager
only). The compile in infra/security/network_policy.py refuses
this file — and any change to it — that gives a live-trading host
any ingress rule at all, so the empty ingress list below is not a
convention the next edit can forget: it is the law, checked.
Addresses are examples for the zone's shape, not real ranges.
